title: Generative AI enhances individual creativity but reduces the collective diversity of novel content
authors: Anil R. Doshi; Oliver Hauser

key_finding: Authors: 'access to generative AI ideas causes stories to be evaluated as more creative, better written, and more enjoyable, especially among less creative writers. caveat_flags: Single session; collective-diversity measure is a cross-sectional similarity statistic within one experiment, not a population over time
